types.name: ClearDraftsError
types.doc: clearDrafts could not delete everything it was asked to (drafts contract section 8). `failed` names the storage; `cause` holds the first underlying error. Whatever could be cleared, was.

types.name: ClearDraftsFailure
types.doc: Where clearDrafts could not delete what it was asked to.

types.name: ClearDraftsOptions
types.doc: One of `scope` or `owner`, never both; or neither, for everything.

members.name: scope
members.doc: Every draft for this scope, across forms.

members.name: owner
members.doc: Every draft recorded with this owner, across scopes and forms — the usual logout call.

types.name: clearDrafts
types.doc: For the host to call, e.g. on logout (drafts contract sections 3 and 8). - `{ owner }`: every device draft and tab entry recorded with that owner, whatever the scope or form. Drafts saved without an owner are not touched. - `{ scope }`: every device draft and tab entry for that scope. - no options: every device draft on this device (the whole database) and every tab entry the package wrote in this tab, scoped or not. Both `scope` and `owner` at once, or options that are not an object: the returned promise rejects with a TypeError (nothing is thrown synchronously). Both at once could mean either their union or their overlap, and a wrong guess deletes drafts. Server drafts are never touched: deleting those is the host's decision. It clears storage, not a form on screen: a form still mounted writes its answers again at its next save, so call it once the form has unmounted. Works without Web Crypto: the hashes fall back to the package's own SHA-256. Where IndexedDB or sessionStorage doesn't exist, nothing was stored there. Rejects with ClearDraftsError when a delete fails, after trying both storages; never resolves without having cleared.
